instruction: Candid documentary medium shot of an indoor wedding venue with white drapes. On the right, the older woman in a floral dress (R1) stands looking down, holding a gold necklace. On the left, the young bride in a red dress (R2) stands holding a rose bouquet, looking forward. The older woman prepares the necklace next to the bride. In the bottom right foreground, a blurred bystander's head is partially visible. Bright, warm indoor lighting illuminates the scene, highlighting the vibrant red and floral colors.
